uc.t: Soiling Loss Detection & Cleaning Schedule Optimization
d: Analyses soiling station data, string currents, irradiance and rainfall to estimate soiling loss per block in real time.
Models soiling accumulation rate vs weather/dust events and predicts energy loss trajectory per block.
Advises economically optimal cleaning schedule (which blocks, when) balancing cleaning cost, water use and recovered generation.
p: Cleaning done on fixed calendar, not on measured soiling
Soiling loss varies 1-4% by block; uniform cleaning wastes money
Post-dust-storm response slow
Water cost and availability constraints not factored
No per-block soiling visibility
kpi: Cleaning cycles per year and cost per cycle
uc.calc: Soiling loss reduction 1% × 100 MW × 20% CUF × 8,760 hr × ₹3/kWh ≈ ₹5.2 cr/yr gross; capture ~25% net of cleaning cost = ₹1.3-1.5 cr per 100 MW per year.

d: Analyses SMB/string currents, voltages and inverter data normalized against irradiance and temperature.
Detects underperforming, open or mismatched strings, blown fuses, connector degradation and MPPT clipping anomalies.
Ranks losses by ₹ impact and generates location-tagged work orders for field technicians.
p: String faults hidden inside healthy inverter totals for weeks
Manual thermography/IV curve checks cover a small sample
Field teams chase alarms, not ₹-ranked losses
Connector burnouts detected only after fire/failure
0.5-2% of energy silently lost at string level
kpi: Mean time to detect string fault (days → hours)
uc.calc: Recoverable string losses 1% × 100 MW × 20% CUF × 8,760 × ₹3/kWh ≈ ₹5.2 cr; capture 35-40% = ₹2 cr per 100 MW per year.

d: Analyses drone IR/RGB imagery of the full array (quarterly or post-event flights).
Detects hotspots, bypass diode failures, PID, cracked/delaminated modules, shattered glass and vegetation shading with GPS-tagged defect maps.
Tracks defect growth across flights and prioritizes module replacement/warranty claims.
p: Manual thermography covers <5% of modules
Diode failures and PID progress silently
Warranty claims fail for lack of documented evidence
Full-plant inspection takes months manually
Defect location records poor; repeat visits wasted
uc.calc: Module defect losses 0.3-0.5% recovered + warranty recovery on defective lots (₹20-50 lakh/claim). ₹1 cr per 100 MW per year.

d: Analyses tracker motor currents, tilt-angle feedback vs astronomical setpoint, stow events and block-level generation deltas.
Detects stuck/lagging trackers, misalignment, backlash, drive wear and wrongly stowed rows.
Provides location-tagged repair lists and validates post-repair recovery.
p: A few degrees of misalignment costs 1-3% on affected rows, invisible in plant totals
Stuck trackers found only on patrol rounds
Wind-stow failures risk structural damage
Drive wear unmonitored until seizure
Tracker OEM portal not integrated with SCADA analytics
kpi: Stuck-tracker count and mean time to fix
uc.calc: Tracker loss recovery 0.3-0.6% of generation + avoided structural damage from stow failures. ₹1 cr per 100 MW per year.

d: Builds a physics + ML expected-energy model (digital twin) from irradiance, temperature and as-built design.
Decomposes PR gap into soiling, downtime, clipping, degradation, curtailment and unexplained loss buckets.
Tracks module degradation rate per block against warranty curve and flags abnormal fade for claims.
p: PR reported but not decomposed; teams argue causes
Degradation above warranty (>0.7%/yr) goes unnoticed for years
Loss accounting manual, inconsistent across sites
Underperformance disputes with O&M contractor unresolved
Board reporting lacks defensible loss waterfall
kpi: PR % and PR gap vs expected
uc.calc: Faster loss attribution recovers 0.2-0.4% energy + degradation warranty claims (₹50 lakh-2 cr episodic). ₹1 cr per 100 MW per year.

d: Analyses inverter IGBT temperatures, fan speeds, DC/AC ripple, event logs and derating patterns.
Predicts fan/filter failures, IGBT degradation, cooling issues and impending trips; detects thermal derating before energy loss compounds.
Provides spare-part staging and intervention scheduling ahead of failure, prioritized by ₹ exposure.
p: Inverter trips discovered on generation dip, not before
Fan/filter failures cause silent thermal derating in summer
Spares not staged; MTTR stretched by logistics
OEM AMC response times slow
Central inverter failure = 2-5 MW offline for days
uc.calc: Availability improvement 0.3-0.5% × 100 MW × 20% CUF × ₹3/kWh ≈ ₹1.5-2.5 cr; plus derating recovery in summer months. Net ₹1.5 cr per 100 MW per year.

d: Analyses satellite/NWP weather feeds, sky cameras, plant telemetry and historical output to produce day-ahead and intra-day forecasts.
Optimizes revision strategy within DSM windows to minimize deviation penalties under state/CERC DSM regulations.
Provides automated schedule submission and penalty attribution dashboards.
p: DSM penalties of ₹1-4 lakh/MW/yr common with poor forecasts
Manual forecasting/revision discipline weak
Cloud transients cause large intra-day deviations
Penalty attribution (forecast vs plant fault) unclear
Regulatory DSM bands tightening
uc.calc: Baseline penalty ₹2-3 lakh/MW/yr × 100 MW = ₹2-3 cr; 50-60% reduction via better forecasts + revision optimization = ₹1.5-2 cr per 100 MW per year.

d: Analyses IDT/power transformer oil temperature, load, DGA (online/offline), OLTC operations and breaker signatures.
Predicts transformer hotspots, insulation ageing and OLTC/breaker mechanism issues.
Provides asset health index and maintenance prioritization for the evacuation path (single point of failure).
p: Evacuation transformer failure = full plant offline (weeks for replacement)
DGA sampling infrequent; incipient faults missed
OLTC issues found only on failure
Switchyard maintenance calendar-based
No health index across ICR/IDT fleet
uc.calc: Avoided transformer failure (₹3-8 cr replacement + 4-12 weeks × full plant revenue ₹4-5 cr/month) × probability reduction. Annualized ₹1 cr per 100 MW per year.

d: Analyses CCTV/thermal camera feeds along plant perimeter and inverter rooms with CV models.
Detects intrusion, cable/module theft attempts, unauthorized vehicle entry and after-hours movement.
Provides real-time alerts to control room and security response, replacing continuous manual monitoring.
p: Copper cable and module theft endemic at remote sites
Guards cannot watch long perimeters 24/7
CCTV recorded but not monitored in real time
Theft discovered next morning; recovery rare
Insurance premiums rising with claims
uc.calc: Theft losses ₹20-60 lakh/yr typical remote site + outage avoidance + manpower rationalization. ₹0.5 cr per 100 MW per year.

uc.vt: Enabler for all other use cases (no standalone ₹ impact)
d: Foundational layer: unified data model across inverter OEMs, SMBs, trackers, WMS, meters and substation into one historian/namespace.
Enables every analytics use case with clean, tagged, contextual data across multi-OEM fleets.
Provides portfolio benchmarking, role-based dashboards and API access for AI models.
p: Every OEM has its own portal; no single source of truth
Portfolio comparisons manual in Excel
Analytics projects stall on data plumbing
Historian gaps break ML models
New site onboarding takes months
uc.calc: Enabler — value realized through downstream use cases.
